module.name: Market Intelligence & Pricing Module
module.description: Real-time commodity price tracking, supply-demand dynamics, competitive pricing intelligence, price forecasting models, volume discount optimization, and market volatility analysis across all major commodities and product categories.
module.expansion_logic: Price parameters tracked for 50+ commodities, 10M+ products, 500K+ suppliers. Historical price data stored for 5+ years with daily granularity. Price forecasts generated daily for 7-day, 30-day, and 90-day horizons.

parameters.name: commodity_spot_price_usd
parameters.purpose: Current spot price for commodity in USD (e.g., steel, aluminum, copper, oil).

parameters.name: commodity_price_change_24h_percent
parameters.purpose: Percentage change in commodity price in last 24 hours.

parameters.name: commodity_price_volatility_30d
parameters.purpose: 30-day price volatility (standard deviation) for commodity.

parameters.name: commodity_price_forecast_7d_usd
parameters.purpose: 7-day price forecast for commodity.

parameters.name: commodity_price_forecast_30d_usd
parameters.purpose: 30-day price forecast for commodity.

parameters.name: commodity_price_forecast_90d_usd
parameters.purpose: 90-day price forecast for commodity.

parameters.name: product_unit_price_current_usd
parameters.purpose: Current unit price for product from supplier (latest quote or transaction).

parameters.name: product_unit_price_historical_avg_12m_usd
parameters.purpose: 12-month historical average unit price for product from supplier.

parameters.name: product_unit_price_variance_vs_historical_percent
parameters.purpose: Percentage variance of current price vs historical average.

parameters.name: product_unit_price_competitive_benchmark_usd
parameters.purpose: Competitive benchmark price (average from multiple suppliers for same product).

parameters.name: product_price_competitiveness_score
parameters.purpose: 0-100 competitiveness score (0=highest price, 100=lowest price vs competitors).

parameters.name: product_price_forecast_30d_usd
parameters.purpose: 30-day price forecast for product from supplier.

parameters.name: product_price_elasticity_estimate
parameters.purpose: Estimated price elasticity of demand (% demand change / % price change).

parameters.name: supplier_volume_discount_tier_1_threshold_units
parameters.purpose: Volume threshold for Tier 1 discount (minimum units).

parameters.name: supplier_volume_discount_tier_1_percent
parameters.purpose: Discount percentage for Tier 1 volume.

parameters.name: supply_demand_balance_index
parameters.purpose: Supply-demand balance index for product category (-100=oversupply, 0=balanced, +100=shortage).

parameters.name: market_shortage_risk_score
parameters.purpose: 0-100 risk score for market shortage in next 90 days.

parameters.name: price_spike_probability_30d_percent
parameters.purpose: Probability of price spike (>20% increase) in next 30 days.

parameters.name: composite_market_risk_score
parameters.purpose: 0-100 composite market risk score (volatility, shortage, forecast uncertainty).

parameters.name: recommended_purchase_timing_days
parameters.purpose: Recommended days to wait before purchasing (negative=buy now, positive=wait).
